Name: Symbolic Health and Energy Icons
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#ffe599]Just a ltttle UI retexture mod that changes HP and Energy icons into more symbolic Heart and Arrow icons.
[b]Use Generic Mod Config Menu mod to pick color variants you like the most![/b][/color]
[/size][/center] [size=3]
[b]Note:[/b] [color=#ff0000][b]Heart [/b][/color]and[color=#00ff00] [b]Energy[/b][/color] icons are configured separately (for example, you can have pink heart and blue energy icons).
[b]In case if none of those match [/b]- you can add your own recolor! For that follow the instruction:

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Go to mod's "Icons" folder and search for "TextureName_Custom" png files.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open them with any image editor and edit the colors, save the changes.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch game and set recolor options to "Custom" in mod config.[/size]
[/list][size=2]---------------------[/size]
[size=3][b]Available colors:
[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][color=#00FF66][size=3][b]Green[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#32CD32][size=3][b]DarkGreen[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#FF2B2B][size=3][b]Red[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#FF66CC][size=3][b]Rose[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#FF99CC][size=3][b]Pink[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00FFFF][size=3][b]Cyan[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#7D00FF][size=3][b]Iridium[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#FFD700][size=3][b]Gold[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#B87333][size=3][b]Copper[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#C0C0C0][size=3][b]Silver[/b][/size][/color]
[*][b][color=#93c47d][size=3]Bog's Style - Green[/size][/color][/b]
[*][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]Bog's Style - Purple[/size][/color][/b]
[*][color=#00BFFF][size=3][b]Custom[/b][/size][/color]
[/list][color=#00bfff][b]

[/b][/color][size=2]---------------------

---------------------
[b]In case if you need compatibility with other mods: 
[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Go to "Frames" folder and search for "BarsFrame_Custom.png file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open them with any image editor and edit the colors, save the changes.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch game and set "Personal Frames Recolor" option to "Custom" in mod config.[/size]
[/list]
